_about: Kitchen equipment and utensils, bought from the catering supplies site. price is per item (per pack when pack > 1). rule says what the game uses it for (see scripts/equip.gd). starters are the kits you begin with. Rename the shop here.

shop.name: KitBox Catering Supplies
shop.tagline: Everything for the professional kitchen. Next working day delivery, free over $50.
shop.desc: Pizza tools, prep kit, storage, cleaning, tableware and safety equipment.

items.name: Portion ladle, 1 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 1 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Portion ladle, 2 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 2 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Portion ladle, 3 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 3 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Portion ladle, 4 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 4 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Portion ladle, 6 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 6 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Portion ladle, 8 oz
items.desc: One scoop is exactly 8 oz of sauce. Everyone saucing at once needs their own.

items.name: Aluminium pizza peel, 12 inch
items.desc: Loads pizzas into the oven and takes them out. One per person working the oven.

items.name: Round turning peel, 8 inch
items.desc: Turns pizzas in the oven so they colour evenly. Needed to turn in gas and wood ovens.

items.name: Pizza cutter wheel, 4 inch
items.desc: Clean slices. Without one you are cutting with a knife and it shows. One per person at the pass.

items.name: Rocking pizza cutter, 20 inch
items.desc: One rock through the whole pizza: the cleanest, quickest slices.

items.name: Stainless bench scraper
items.desc: Cuts and lifts dough. Without one your dough balls come out uneven.

items.name: Wooden rolling pin, 18 inch
items.desc: Needed to roll thin Roman bases (unless you have a dough sheeter).

items.name: Dough docker
items.desc: Pricks rolled bases so they do not bubble up in the oven.

items.name: Deep pan pizza tin, 10 inch
items.desc: One deep-pan pizza per tin, from the bench to the board.

items.name: Dough proving tray with lid, 600 x 400
items.desc: Holds 12 dough balls while they proof. No tray space, no dough.

items.name: Pizza oven brush and scraper
items.desc: Sweeps ash off the oven floor. Without it, wood-fired bases pick up ash.

items.name: Infrared thermometer
items.desc: Reads the oven floor and the fire, so you know exactly how hot it is.

items.name: Wooden pizza serving board, 12 inch
items.desc: Pizzas brought to the table on a board look the part. One per seat for dine-in.

items.name: Chef's knife, 8 inch
items.desc: Needed for any knife prep: slicing, dicing, halving. One per person prepping.

items.name: Chopping board, green
items.desc: Colour-coded: salad, veg and herbs only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Chopping board, red
items.desc: Colour-coded: raw meat only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Chopping board, yellow
items.desc: Colour-coded: cooked and cured meat only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Chopping board, blue
items.desc: Colour-coded: fish only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Chopping board, white
items.desc: Colour-coded: dairy and bakery only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Chopping board, brown
items.desc: Colour-coded: root veg: onions, potatoes, garlic only. Prep on the wrong colour and the inspector will notice.

items.name: Allergen chopping board, purple
items.desc: Allergy orders are prepped on purple. With the purple board and knife, staff rarely get an allergy order wrong.

items.name: Allergen knife, purple
items.desc: Goes with the purple board for allergy orders.

items.name: Box grater
items.desc: Needed to grate cheese.

items.name: Bench rotary grater
items.desc: Grates a kilo of cheese in a fraction of the time.

items.name: Stick blender, 300 mm
items.desc: Blitzes tins into sauce. Without one, sauce is crushed by hand and takes far longer.

items.name: Stainless colander
items.desc: Needed to drain tins and wash leaves.

items.name: Aluminium frying pan, 28 cm
items.desc: Needed to cook sausage, render pancetta, saute greens.

items.name: Stainless saucepan, 3.5 litre
items.desc: For white sauce, blanching and defrosting. Counts as a pan for cooking prep.

items.name: Stainless mixing bowl, 5 litre
items.desc: Needed to mix dough by hand when you have no mixer.

items.name: Measuring jug, 2 litre
items.desc: Measures the water for dough. Without one you are guessing.

items.name: Digital scales, 5 kg
items.desc: Weighs dough ingredients and toppings to the gram. Without scales you only get rough readings.

items.name: Probe thermometer
items.desc: Checks cooked food is hot right through. The inspector expects one if you cook anything.

items.name: Gastronorm pan 1/6, 100 mm
items.desc: Small pan for the counter rail (stainless bench and refrigerated counter).

items.name: Gastronorm pan 1/3, 100 mm
items.desc: Large pan for the marble-top pizza counters.

items.name: Fridge and freezer thermometer
items.desc: One in each fridge and freezer. You cannot keep the temperature log without them.

items.name: Day-dot labels, roll of 1000
items.desc: One on every tub you prep, coloured for the day. Unlabelled food fails inspections.

items.name: Mop and bucket, red (kitchen)
items.desc: Colour-coded for the kitchen. Without one the kitchen floor never comes clean.

items.name: Mop and bucket, blue (front of house)
items.desc: Colour-coded for the front. Without one the dining room never comes clean.

items.name: Spray bottle, 750 ml
items.desc: Needed to spray cleaning chemicals.

items.name: Cleaning cloths, pack of 50
items.desc: Every clean uses a few. No cloths, no proper clean.

items.name: Pizza plate, 12 inch, pack of 6
items.desc: One per seated guest. You can only seat as many guests as you have plates, cutlery and glasses.

items.name: Knife and fork sets, pack of 12
items.desc: One set per seated guest.

items.name: Hi-ball glasses, pack of 24
items.desc: One per seated guest.

items.name: Insulated delivery bag, holds 3 pizzas
items.desc: One per delivery driver. Without one, deliveries arrive cold.

items.name: Catering first aid kit, blue plasters
items.desc: Required by law. The inspector checks.

items.name: Fire blanket, 1.2 m
items.desc: Required in every kitchen. The inspector checks.

items.name: CO2 fire extinguisher, 2 kg
items.desc: Required by law. The inspector checks.

items.name: Hand-wash station kit: soap and paper towel dispensers
items.desc: A proper hand-wash point. The inspector checks.
